close_reason: Shipped via PR #1 squash c37cf5a. Deploy-verification protocol at MAJOR_PLINY.md §6 close-of-arc list. GitHub Deployments API as authoritative truth signal (gh api repos/<repo>/deployments + statuses); /api/health 200 explicitly framed as corroborating-not-authoritative.
description:
Surfaced 2026-05-07 by MAJOR PLINY in ariadne-core-workspace during Batch H execution. Substrate-side counterpart to the empirical correction PLINY made mid-batch.

## Background

For Batch G + first half of Batch H, PLINY's ship-surface routine claimed 'deploy verified via /api/health 200' as the truth signal. PLINY surfaced mid-batch that this claim was weaker than framed:

  /api/health returns {"status":"healthy","version":"0.1.0",...}
  version is hardcoded, not commit-derived.

So /api/health 200 only confirms 'Railway didn't fall over during the deploy window' — it cannot distinguish 'new commit live' from 'previous deploy still serving' on its own. PLINY caught this and self-corrected the protocol mid-batch.

## Real truth signal

GitHub Deployments API (which Railway integrates with):

    gh api repos/<repo>/deployments --jq '.[0:3]'
    gh api repos/<repo>/deployments/<id>/statuses

A 'success' state record on the deployment associated with the new SHA is the truth signal that the new container is live. /api/health 200 is corroborating sanity check (service responsive + not 5xx-ing), not authority.

PLINY backfilled this discipline mid-batch and applied it to 90e + qe6 + opq+tjw.1+4d1 trio + b1q deploys. Worked as designed.

## Scope of this ticket

Update MAJOR_PLINY.md ship-surface routine (§ closing-the-engagement / ship section, wherever the deploy-verification step is documented) to make the canonical protocol:

1. PRIMARY: gh api repos/<repo>/deployments --jq '.[0:3]' to get the latest deployment record.
2. PRIMARY: gh api repos/<repo>/deployments/<id>/statuses to confirm success state on the new SHA's deployment.
3. CORROBORATING: /api/health 200 as service-responsive sanity check.

Frame /api/health 200 explicitly as 'corroborating, not authoritative.' Note the version-field gap (cross-reference the ariadne-side ticket for making /api/health version commit-SHA-derived; once that ships, /api/health upgrades from 'corroborating' to 'co-authoritative').

## Out of scope

- Patching /api/health itself — that's the ariadne-side ticket (will reference once filed).
- Backfilling old close-out comments — PLINY committed to backfill 2tz/ucw/tol comments when convenient; that's PLINY's housekeeping, not a substrate ticket.

## Gauntlet

ADA + CATO eyeball. Skip DAEDALUS/ARGUS/VERA/ZENO. Single-file substrate edit; no code change.

## Sequencing

Not blocking anything. Pick up post-Batch-H along with the activation-reflex breadcrumb ticket (stoa--7kg.2) — both are MAJOR_PLINY.md substrate edits and could ride together if convenient.

## Empirical anchor

PLINY's mid-batch self-correction surface in the ariadne-core-workspace session 2026-05-07. Truth-signal protocol verified working on 90e + qe6 + trio + b1q deploys.
